summary: Iteration 13 covered the full Cash/Bank TRANSFER (contra), Party-Ledger STATEMENT with date-range opening, Dashboard Cash & Bank Balance card, and v1.0.0 version/branding features end-to-end. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration13.py with 14 pytest cases - ALL PASS (14/14). BACKEND verified: (1) POST /api/rokad/transfer {307->301, 50000, 2026-06-10} returns 200 with contra_id, legs[2] (jama+kharch), from_account_name 'SBICC-M M TRD.' and to_account_name 'CASH IN HAND'; (2) /api/rokad/accounts-summary reflects deltas: 301 jama +50000 & closing +50000, 307 kharch +50000 & closing -50000; total.closing unchanged; (3) GET /api/rokad shows both legs with contra_id and party_name 'Transfer -> CASH IN HAND' / 'Transfer <- SBICC-M M TRD.'; (4) GET /api/rokad/transfer/{contra_id} roundtrip; (5) PUT /api/rokad/transfer/{contra_id} {60000, 2026-06-11} - leg IDs preserved, amount/date updated; (6) PUT /api/rokad/{leg_id} returns 400 'Transfer form se edit karein'; (7) same from/to -> 400; (8) non-cash ledger as from -> 400; (9) DELETE one leg removes both (GET transfer -> 404); (10) /api/summary/party/<301>?date_from=2026-06-10&as_on=2026-06-11 includes transfer in cash_rokad while it exists; (11) /api/summary/party/<307>?date_from=2026-05-01&as_on=2026-05-05 returns date_from, as_on, opening=-36696088.0, party.balance=-44387254.0, and only entries dated within range; (12) Without date_from opening equals party.opening_balance; (13) Bad date -> 400. FRONTEND via Playwright: (a) Login page footer-version='9x Vyapari v1.0.0 (web)', in-app footer same, Help (?) overlay shows about-version containing 'Version v1.0.0 (web)'. (b) Dashboard cash-bank-balances renders 7 rows (301,302,303,304,306,307 + Cash IN Hand), each row has cash-bank-balance-*; values match /api/rokad/accounts-summary for today (301 Rs 97,01,179.00 Dr, 307 Rs 4,43,87,254.00 Cr); cash-bank-total 'Kul Cash + Bank Rs 2,60,74,282.19 Cr' matches total.closing; cash-bank-open-rokad link present; clicking row 5cc51379-... (307) navigates to /parties/<307>. (c) Party ledger /parties/<307>?from=2026-05-01&as_on=2026-05-05: default From=2026-04-01 (FY start), As on=today; input-ledger-from/input-ledger-as-on both wired; URL has from=&as_on=; ledger-opening='Opening (01-05-2026 se pehle): Rs 3,66,96,088.00 Cr'; ledger-opening-row present; ledger-entry-count '8 entries' (<15); party-balance 'Rs 4,43,87,254.00 Cr'; ledger-closing-row 'CLOSING BALANCE AS ON 05-05-2026 Rs 4,43,87,254.00 Cr'; last running balance == closing. (d) btn-toggle-statement -> party-statement visible with header '9x Vyapari / Ledger Account Statement', 'Party : SBICC-M M TRD. (Code 307)', 'Period : 01-05-2026 To 05-05-2026', stmt-opening-row '01-05-2026 OPENING BALANCE (B/F) 3,66,96,088.00 Cr', stmt-total-row 'TOTAL (8 entries) 24,00,000.00 1,00,91,166.00', stmt-closing-row 'CLOSING BALANCE AS ON 05-05-2026 4,43,87,254.00 Cr'; footer in statement reads '9X VYAPARI V1.0.0 (WEB)'; table-ledger hidden. Print emulation: stmt visible, table hidden. Toggle back -> table visible, stmt hidden. 'Shuru se' button -> From cleared; ledger-opening='Opening: Rs 2,86,16,472.00 Cr' (= party.opening_balance); statement opening row 'OPENING BALANCE 2,86,16,472.00 Cr' (no B/F). (e) /rokad: btn-transfer opens transfer-modal; selecting From=307 disables 307 in To select; selecting To=301, amount=25000, date=2026-06-10, description -> transfer-preview 'SBICC-M M TRD.: Kharch Rs 25,000.00 -> CASH IN HAND: Jama Rs 25,000.00'; transfer-submit creates (modal closes); 2 rokad-contra-badge-* visible under 06-10; summary table shows 301 jama Rs 25,000.00 & closing +25k, 307 kharch Rs 25,000.00 & closing -25k. Edit (rokad-edit-*) on transfer leg opens Transfer Edit modal prefilled {amt=25000, date=2026-06-10, from=307_id, to=301_id}; typing 30000 + submit -> modal closes, BOTH legs re-render with 'Rs 30,000.00'. Delete (rokad-del-*) triggers window.confirm with text 'Yeh Transfer entry hai - dono accounts se hat jayegi. Delete karein?' (mentions dono accounts) - dialog accepted and both legs are removed server-side (verified via API: contra entries gone). (f) Regression: /accounts btn-new-account opens Naya Account modal with input-account-name auto-focused (typing works); keyboard shortcut 'a' also opens with input focused; /opening-balance, /trial-balance, /settings pages all load without errors. All cleanup done - no residual contra rokad entries at EOT.

issues: about-version text contains a leading separator dot: '· Version v1.0.0 (web)' - cosmetic, acceptable, label still readable.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py transfer endpoints (_transfer_legs/_transfer_out, POST/GET/PUT /rokad/transfer, DELETE /rokad/{id}) are clean, correctly validate same-id and non-cash cases, and preserve leg IDs on update (kharch-first sort trick) - good.
Normal PUT /rokad/{rid} with contra_id now 400s with explicit Hindi message - good UX.
DELETE /rokad/{rid} auto-cascades contra leg deletion via delete_many on contra_id - correct.
_summary_party now supports date_from and returns opening = balance-as-on-(date_from - 1 day); when date_from absent opening falls back to party.opening_balance - matches spec exactly.
No MongoDB _id leaks observed in any tested endpoint.
server.py is now ~2470 lines; prior iteration also noted - still worth splitting into feature routers (rokad, parties, summary, auth, backup).
